senses.gloss: dāgha, m. (recorded only for Pkt. in Hem. 〔1.264〕, but cf. Skt. nidāgha), burning, conflagration: (geha-)dāghā vā kṛtā bhavanti vana-dāghā … Mv 〔i.23.1〕 (prose); dāgho ca utpanno … nirvāpitaḥ 〔ii.181.2〕; (śīlena pariśuddhena kāyo bhoti prabhāsvaro,) na cāsya jāyate dāgho (but v.l. doṣo, perhaps better) maraṇe pratyupasthite Mv 〔ii.358.14〕 (vs); agnidāghaṃ (pari-)nirvāpayituṃ 〔ii.457.9, 13〕, also hasti-dāghaṃ 12, conflagration (burning) of elephants.
